It's just like the place that Grandma Ryano told\nme when I was a kid... The place where dead people\ngather before going to the Dark Realm...
Ohhh? How rare to see living people.
Y-Y-You're... a ghost?
Yea.
N-N-No... Nooooooooo!
It's no surprise. It's Calle Mort which means\n"The Road of the Dead". Souls of the dead\ncome here before going to the Dark Realm.
T-The Road of the Dead...? I-I-...\nI can't b-b-believe it really e-exists...Oh, no...\nWhat sorta place have I brought myself to?
...Huh? How to get to Eldenbaum?\nI have no idea. You might want to ask the Elder\nof Lunite Village about that kind of thing.
Where? Oh, she should be over there.
Watch your step!
The Elder welcomed you for coming all the way on\nKing Elbano's order...
What? How did you know that?
We're the villagers of Lunite...Last night, the\nmoon & the stars in the night sky told us about it\nincluding your plan to go to Eldenbaum...
She said she knew you're going to Eldenbaum,\nbut she had a favor to ask you...
At the top of Lunagent Mountain, there is a road\nfor the souls of the dead to go to the Dark Realm\ncalled the "Road to Darkness".
But a mysterious monster is blocking off the road.\nAs a result, the souls got stuck and turned evil.\nNow, they're doing harm to our village...
Don't tell us your request is...
...Right. Since you've got guts, she'd like to ask\nif you're willing to defeat the monster and purify\nthe souls that turned evil on the mountain...
...What? There's no turning back, right?\n...G-Ghosts? I-I-I'm not s-scared at all\nif it's for my reward... Ha, ha...
Very well. But before that, she said she'd like to\nsee if you're strong enough to purify the souls.
So, please defeat the monsters listed on this\nnote...Here you are.
You received the note from the servant.
Oh, well done. Now, she'll give the ability to\npurify the evil souls to your weapon...
She wants you to show her your weapon and\nclose your eyes for a second.
That should do it.\nDefeat the monster and purify the souls at the\nmountain. She said she's counting on you...
There's nothing I can sell you.\nSorry.
Wind Ark? I have no idea...\nIf it's the flying spirits or monsters here, then\nI've seen way too many that I'm sick of them...
This isn't a place for people like you.\nHurry back to where you came from or pass through\nhere right now.
A flying ship in the air? What's that?\nI've never seen it...By the way, this isn't a\nplace for people like you.
Hurry back to where you came from or pass through\nhere right now.
We've been managing the road to the Dark Realm\nsince the ancient times, but the road moved to\nthe top of the mountain after the Cataclysm.
Since then, the souls that are going to the Dark\nRealm and those coming out from it are drifting\nbetween the mountain and this village.
It's not like they do harm to us, but\nthe atmosphere turned gloomy because of that...\nshe said.
Nooooaaggh!!
I-Is it... you...? Really?\nNot a ghost... Y-You're alive?!
Oooohh, thank god!\nI was so worried cuz let alone my reward,\nI've not even collected your debt!!
[She's slick and always prioritizes her own\ninterests but she's not a bad girl...]\nFida's words are somehow audible...
Oh? What a coincidence! Didn't expect to see you\nguys again...
Oh...y-you're...\nT-t-the ghost we met the other day?
Yea!
Holy moly! Y-y-you're still here! Gosh...\nHey, hey, don't you think he might know about it?
...Huh? A flying ship...?\nNope, I've no clue about it.\nMoreover, I'm not here during the day...
The person who saw it flying around here? In that\ncase, you should ask the Elder of Lunite Village.\nShe would know if anything strange happens.
The Elder welcomed you for coming all the way on\nKing Elbano's order.
...She said she had also heard about the Wind\nArk...a flying ship that is controlled by the\nGoddess of Wind...
But she said she forgot who told her about it...\nWait, that was the thing I saw though...
What? Really? You saw it?
Yes...it looked like a huge ship. I saw it flying\ndown unsteadily toward Lunagent Mountain...
It flew down you said?\nWhereabouts in Lunagent Mountain?
The problem is...the entire Lunagent Mountain was\nsurrounded by clouds that day, so I didn't know\nwhere it landed...
That's no good then...
She asked if you could drive out the creatures\nsettling illegally in Lunagent Mountain if you're\ngoing there.
What?!
She said there have been some signs of life under\nthe cliff of Calle Mort, but no one has clearly\nseen what's down there.
There is a "Darkness Road" in Lunagent Mountain\nthat the souls of the dead use to get to the\nDark Realm, if it gets occupied and blocked,
She's worried that all the souls that get stuck\nthere would turn evil and that would be\ntroublesome!
Aaaahh!! H-h-heyyy, you know I hate ghosts,\nyou're doing it on purpose, don't you?!\nO-o-o-our goal is to find the Wind Ark...
Mam! There's a monster in the square!!
Whaat?! That monster is sending the ghosts\nflying!! What's the meaning of this??
It looks like an evil spirit that has turned into\na monster. Whatever it is, you can't just ignore\nand do nothing about it!
Heyy!\nI told you I'm scared of ghosts!!
A-a-all this cheering and clapping\nd-d-doesn't really please me...
Thank you. I'm here to relay the message from the\nelder once again. If you happen to see the illegal\ninhabitants we mentioned earlier while
searching for the Wind Ark, she wants you to drive\nthem out...Could you do that?
Fine if you insist. Well, it's gonna be this\nadventurer's job anyway, plus Reliza and\nthe others would help too, so should be fine.
Tell her that we'll do it.
EVENT BATTLE\nExterminate the evil spirit monster!!
Hey! There's something under the cliff!!
The gondola is ready! We can head down!
Hello...Yes, everything is fine.\nBut sometimes the pale things that are roaming\naround kinda give me the chills...
The warrior who built this gondola also said that\nsomething seemed to be down there. He didn't see\nhow it looked like but he felt its presence...
I think it's dangerous since we\ndon't know what it is.\nPlease be very careful if you are going down!
EVENT BATTLE\nDefeat the evil spirits and purify them!!
Oh gosh, t-they're hereeee!!
Aight, let's do this!!
Phew...Seems like we managed to purify the spirits\nand send them to the Dark Realm...
Pelulu's up, guys~
Oh, did you sleep well?
Stop teasing me!\n...U-uh, thanks guys and I'm sorry that I couldn't\nhelp...I'm ashamed of myself...
Thank you everyone. I'm glad everyone is okay.\nNow the spirits shouldn't be causing any trouble\nfor a while...
We should clear the way for the spirits before\nthe remaining evil spirits turn brutal...
Let us go persuade the Injes to vacate this place.
